en: You have come to learn of battles won and lost on this field? There are no winners here...

adventurer, it's good to see veterans like you in the field! I'm sorry to report that our supplies are currently too low to launch any large ground assaults against the Horde.

Speak with our quartermaster; he has supply missions available.
Well done, soldier. A few more and our stables will be overflowing with mounts for the cavalry to ride into combat!
Greetings, soldier. Are you here to help the cause?
The indigenous rams of Alterac are vital to the functionality of our cavalry!
Just a few more and our stables will be overflowing with mounts. Release it into my custody, soldier. I'll take it from here.
